title: Lighter's StablecoinX Perp vs USDE: Tracking and Funding
headline: Does Lighter's StablecoinX perp track USDE?
name: Lighter's StablecoinX perp review
description: Lighter's StablecoinX perp mark ended within 1% of the close of USDE, StablecoinX's Nasdaq stock, on 30 of 31 days to October 8, 2026, and its last trade on 14.
imageAlt: Two scatter charts comparing USDE's next opening price with the mark of Lighter's StablecoinX perp at 4 am and 9 am New York time, August 26 to October 8, 2026. The open sat nearer the perp's mark than the prior close 17 of 30 times at 4 am and 23 of 30 times at 9 am.
